answer.text:
The question says "the memo" without naming one, and the passages come from several OMB memos. The 180-day requirements I can find are below, by memo.

**M-25-21 (Accelerating Federal Use of AI):**
- Within 180 days of the memo's issuance or any update to it, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly on its website either a plan to achieve consistency with the memo, or a written determination that it does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI.
- Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with the memo. OMB will provide templates for these compliance plans.

**M-24-10 (March 2024):** It has the same compliance-plan requirement. Within 180 days of issuance or any update, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly either a plan to achieve consistency with the memo or a written determination that it does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI.

**M-25-22 (Acquisition of AI), Appendix I:** The consolidated table of required actions lists a 180-day item in which each agency must achieve full compliance with the guidance of the memorandum (section 2(c)). The table text is garbled, so the pairing of actions and deadlines is my reading of it.

If you meant a specific memo, M-25-21 and M-24-10 both center on the compliance plan, while M-25-22 requires full compliance at 180 days. The passages do not say which memo you meant.
